name: netdiscover
summary: An active/passive address reconnaissance tool, mainly developed for those wireless networks without dhcp server, when you are wardriving. It can be also used on hub/switched networks.
highlights: -l — scan the list of ranges contained into the given file
-m — scan a list of known MACs and host names
-c — number of times to send each ARP request (for nets with packet loss)
usage: netdiscover [-i device] [-r range | -l file | -p] [-m file] [-F filter] [-s time] [-c count] [-n node] [-dfPLNS]
